title: Smart Child
simplified_paragraphs: 有一天，王奶奶看见路边有人正在卖苹果，于是问卖苹果的师傅："苹果怎么卖？”师傅说："两块钱一个，随便您挑。”
王奶奶在那里仔细地挑苹果。这时，一个小男孩突然跑过来，对她说："奶奶，这苹果又大又红，您多买几个吧。”王奶奶笑着说："好，就听你的，多买几个。”小男孩说完后，拿起一个苹果就跑走了。王奶奶挑了八个苹果后，给了师傅十六块钱。没想到，师傅说："不好意思，还差两块钱，刚才你孙子还吃了一个呢。”
王奶奶惊讶地说："我没有孙子啊……我明白了！原来那个男孩不是你儿子啊！”
traditional_paragraphs: 有一天，王奶奶看見路邊有人正在賣蘋果，於是問賣蘋果的師傅："蘋果怎麼賣？”師傅說："兩塊錢一個，隨便您挑。”
王奶奶在那裏仔細地挑蘋果。這時，一個小男孩突然跑過來，對她說："奶奶，這蘋果又大又紅，您多買幾個吧。”王奶奶笑著說："好，就聽你的，多買幾個。”小男孩說完後，拿起一個蘋果就跑走了。王奶奶挑了八個蘋果後，給了師傅十六塊錢。沒想到，師傅說："不好意思，還差兩塊錢，剛才你孫子還吃了一個呢。”
王奶奶驚訝地說："我沒有孫子啊……我明白了！原來那個男孩不是你兒子啊！”
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī tiān， Wáng nǎi nai kàn jiàn lù bian yǒu rén zhèng zài mài píng guǒ， yú shì wèn mài píng guǒ de shī fu：" píng guǒ zěn me mài？” shī fu shuō：" liǎng kuài qián yī gè， suí biàn nín tiāo。”

Wáng nǎi nai zài nà lǐ zǐ xì de tiāo píng guǒ。 zhè shí， yī gè xiǎo nán hái tū rán pǎo guò lái， duì tā shuō：" nǎi nai， zhè píng guǒ yòu dà yòu hóng， nín duō mǎi jǐ gè ba。” Wáng nǎi nai xiào zhe shuō：" hǎo， jiù tīng nǐ de， duō mǎi jǐ gè。” xiǎo nán hái shuō wán hòu， ná qǐ yī gè píng guǒ jiù pǎo zǒu le。 Wáng nǎi nai tiāo le bā gè píng guǒ hòu， gěi le shī fu shí liù kuài qián。 méi xiǎng dào， shī fu shuō：" bù hǎo yì si， hái chà liǎng kuài qián， gāng cái nǐ sūn zi hái chī le yī gè ne。”
Wáng nǎi nai jīng yà de shuō：" wǒ méi yǒu sūn zi a …… wǒ míng bai le！ yuán lái nà gè nán hái bù shì nǐ ér zi a！”
english_paragraphs: One day, Grandma Wang saw someone selling apples by the roadside. She asked the vendor, “How much are the apples?” “Two yuan each,” he said. “Take your pick.”

Grandma Wang carefully picked out some apples. Just then, a little boy ran over and said, “Grandma, these apples are big and red. You should buy a few more!” Grandma Wang smiled. “All right, I’ll take your advice and buy a few more.” The boy grabbed an apple and ran off. After choosing eight apples, Grandma Wang gave the vendor sixteen yuan. To her surprise, he said, “Sorry, you still owe me two yuan. Your grandson took an apple too.”
Grandma Wang said in surprise, “I don’t have a grandson… Oh, I see! So that boy isn’t your son!”
english_full:
One day, Grandma Wang saw someone selling apples by the roadside. She asked the vendor, “How much are the apples?” “Two yuan each,” he said. “Take your pick.”

Grandma Wang carefully picked out some apples. Just then, a little boy ran over and said, “Grandma, these apples are big and red. You should buy a few more!” Grandma Wang smiled. “All right, I’ll take your advice and buy a few more.” The boy grabbed an apple and ran off. After choosing eight apples, Grandma Wang gave the vendor sixteen yuan. To her surprise, he said, “Sorry, you still owe me two yuan. Your grandson took an apple too.”

Grandma Wang said in surprise, “I don’t have a grandson… Oh, I see! So that boy isn’t your son!”
